cmd:
# Check if gitea is already installed
which gitea 2>/dev/null && echo 'GITEA_EXISTS' || echo 'NEED_INSTALL'

# Check available RAM and disk
echo '---'
free -m | head -2
echo '---'
# Check if port 3000 is free
ss -tlnp | grep ':3000' 2>/dev/null || echo 'PORT_3000_FREE'
ss -tlnp | grep ':3001' 2>/dev/null || echo 'PORT_3001_FREE'
